reason: Refuted under the value lens. The mechanism is sound and transfers trivially: it is runtime only, with no learned part and no node-count effect. But the claimed expected gain (+0.0001..+0.0004) is overstated 5-10x, and the realistic value is ~0. (1) Public and private are scored from ONE hidden run (step0.md; v3 budget-aware-deadline value json). A fired 9.5 h deadline therefore shows up in the file's own latency and public score before the 29 Sep 20:00 selection. The §f fallback chain (previous K, K1, ...) then takes over. The loss is capped at the forgone rider gain (~0.001), not the raw degradation. (2) R5(b) already admits a 9.5-10.5 h latency whenever the step-0 forecast has >= 1 h margin. K2's forecast is 7.86 h vs 9.5 h, so the 'admissibility' benefit is mostly redundant. (3) Recomputed worlds, anchored on the UPPER bound K2 <= 7.86 h (L35 7.73 h + 106 x 4.4 s; latency includes queue time, so the true runtime is lower). Inputs: repair 127.3 s/clip, degraded 28.2 s/clip, pre-repair 4.11 h. Both deadlines are identical up to a uniform slowdown s = 1.20. At s = 1.25, 9.5 h degrades 7 clips (not the claimed 26) and 10.5 h degrades 0. At s = 1.30 it is 15 vs 0, at s = 1.40 30 vs 10. With safetail, a degraded clip loses only gap/readmit/relink: ~0.005-0.015 per unit fraction (0.05-0.065 minus safe divisions ~0.036 and linefit ~0.0145), so the difference at s = 1.3 is ~+0.0014. P(s >= 1.25 vs an upper-bound anchor) is ~0.01-0.03, a guess: the ±12% dummy spread is between different code (exp56 vs exp58), not same-code rerun jitter. E ~= 2e-5 private and equal on public. (4) Timeout tail: with the worst degraded clip (45.7 s) the 10.5 h build crosses 12 h at s ~1.9, the 9.5 h build at s ~2.1. That is small and symmetric, since both worlds are heavily degraded and unselected. The idea's '1.24 h worst tail, ends 11.74 h' holds only up to s ~1.5. (5) The change is byte-identical and unobservable in every world with runtime < 9.5 h, so it can never be certified as a gain.
fix: Do not change the whitelist by default. Keep REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200 and DIVINS_DEADLINE_S=28800 (the 8.0 h insertion gate stays, as the idea says). Adopt the free half: a pre-registered runtime ledger in CONTEXT §e. Each rider reports its per-clip 'repair' and 'detection+edges' delta vs K2 from its own dummy. Forecast = L(K2) observed (or 7.86 h) + 106 x sum(deltas) x 1.15. Raise to 37800 (the builder whitelist change plus the test_safetail case) ONLY on a trigger: L(K2) > 8.5 h, OR a ledger forecast for K3/F1-final > 8.5 h. In that world P(fire) becomes material and the option value is real (~+0.001-0.003 conditional). If it is raised, check the timeout tail with the worst degraded clip (45.7 s/clip, not 28.2) against a 12 h clock that starts before KERNEL_START_TS (container start and mounting are not counted). Require 10.5 h + N x 45.7 s x s_forecast <= 11.5 h.
realistic_gain: Public = private (same run): ~0 expected, ~+2e-5 (range 0 to +1e-4). Conditional on a >= 1.25x slower run of K3/F1: +0.001..+0.003, but that world is visible before finals and mostly covered by the fallback to K2. Exactly 0 in every world with runtime < 9.5 h, which covers all observed runs so far (L34 <= 6.46 h, L35 <= 7.73 h).
